line: Crowley's Prince of Cups: Vau of the Name (pdf p139); the airy part of Water and the span from Libra to Scorpio (pdf p153).

sections.title: The court and its element
sections.line: Crowley on the Princes (pdf p139) and on the Prince of Cups (pdf p153).

quotes.quote: The Princes represent the Forces of the letter Vau in the Name.
The Prince of Cups represents the airy part of Water.

sections.title: Its span in the Zodiac
sections.line: Crowley on the span from the 21st degree of Libra to the 20th degree of Scorpio (pdf p153); on the decans and the elemental attribution (pdf p139).

quotes.quote: He rules from the 21st degree of Libra to the 20th degree of Scorpio.
instead of assigning the three decans of each sign to one card, the influence begins with the last decan of one Sign and continues to the second decan of the next.
It might well be expected that the elemental attribution would harmonize with the Zodiacal attribution; but it is not so.

sections.title: Character
sections.line: Crowley on the character of the Prince of Cups (pdf p153).

quotes.quote: The moral characteristics of the person pictured in this card are subtlety, secret violence, and craft.
